entries.claim: The 1846 English Placeat supplies the petition and closes with the single English word “Through.” Its facing Latin gives the full conclusion. The 1853 English Missal prints the complete ending.
entries.reader_note: The 1846 English prayer abbreviates the conclusion to “Through.” The 1853 Missal prints the full English ending.

entries.claim: Holy Trinity, may this act of my service please You. Grant that the sacrifice which I, though unworthy, have offered before Your majesty may be acceptable to You and, through Your mercy, propitiatory for me and for all for whom I offered it. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
